# Stopwatch

A pausable timer over the monotonic clock.

```rux
pub struct Stopwatch {
    // private fields
}
```

`Copy`, owning nothing; a copy is an independent stopwatch with the same history. Starts stopped at zero. The
elapsed time is the sum of every stretch between a start and a stop, plus the current stretch while running.

## Constructors

<h3 id="new"><code>Stopwatch</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Stopwatch() -> Stopwatch
```

A stopwatch that is stopped and reads zero.
Cannot fail and does not read the clock.

**Returns**: a stopped stopwatch at zero

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Time/Src/Stopwatch.rux#L34)

<h3 id="start-new"><code>StartNew</code></h3>

```rux
pub func StartNew() -> Stopwatch
```

A stopwatch that reads zero and is already running.
Reads the clock once. Cannot fail.

**Returns**: a running stopwatch, started now

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Time/Src/Stopwatch.rux#L42)

## Methods

<h3 id="start"><code>Start</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Start(self: &var Stopwatch)
```

Starts the stopwatch, or resumes it from the total it already holds.
Does nothing when it is already running, so a second start does not restart the current stretch. Cannot fail.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Time/Src/Stopwatch.rux#L51)

<h3 id="stop"><code>Stop</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Stop(self: &var Stopwatch)
```

Stops the stopwatch, adding the current stretch to its total.
Does nothing when it is already stopped. The total then stays fixed until the stopwatch is started again.
Cannot fail.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Time/Src/Stopwatch.rux#L60)

<h3 id="reset"><code>Reset</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Reset(self: &var Stopwatch)
```

Stops the stopwatch and sets it back to zero, clearing the laps.
Cannot fail and does not read the clock.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Time/Src/Stopwatch.rux#L69)

<h3 id="restart"><code>Restart</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Restart(self: &var Stopwatch)
```

Sets the stopwatch back to zero, clearing the laps, and starts it.
The same as [`Reset`](/docs/api/time/stopwatch#reset) followed by [`Start`](/docs/api/time/stopwatch#start), with one clock reading. Cannot fail.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Time/Src/Stopwatch.rux#L78)

<h3 id="is-running"><code>IsRunning</code></h3>

```rux
pub func IsRunning(self: &Stopwatch) -> bool
```

Whether the stopwatch is running.
Cannot fail and does not read the clock.

**Returns**: true between a start and the next stop or reset

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Time/Src/Stopwatch.rux#L87)

<h3 id="elapsed"><code>Elapsed</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Elapsed(self: &Stopwatch) -> Duration
```

The total elapsed time: every finished stretch, plus the current one while running.
Reading it does not stop or otherwise change the stopwatch. Reads the clock only while running, and two
readings of a stopped stopwatch are equal. Cannot fail.

**Returns**: the elapsed time, never negative

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Time/Src/Stopwatch.rux#L99)

<h3 id="lap"><code>Lap</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Lap(self: &var Stopwatch) -> Duration
```

Ends the current lap and returns its length: the elapsed time since the previous lap ended, or since zero.
The stopwatch keeps running or stays stopped as it was; only time the stopwatch counted is part of a lap, so a
lap spanning a pause excludes the pause. The laps since the last reset add up to the elapsed time at the end of
the last one. Cannot fail.

**Returns**: the length of the lap just ended, never negative

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Time/Src/Stopwatch.rux#L112)
